acceptance: At enforce, a tdd deliverable whose predicate has an inverted-idiom or go-run-exit-code finding is rejected with the finding and remedy in the reason (red first)
An absence-message finding and every flaky-shape finding still never block
At shadow every kind is logged and approved
fix: Give predicateLintGate a per-finding blocking predicate (a strategy, not a flag): Gate E blocks when any finding's kind is inverted-idiom or go-run-exit-code, under the existing eval_gate stage dial (block only at enforce); absence-message and every Gate D finding stay advisory. Name the remedy in the correction directive.
summary: The unsatisfiable-predicate lint's inverted-idiom and go-run-exit-code kinds are proofs (red on every tree; an exit code go run cannot return), and the corpus test asserts the committed go/acs corpus holds none. Gate E still returns block=false for every kind, so a cycle's own new unsatisfiable predicate is only logged at the end of tdd and burns the build anyway.
title: Gate E blocks the provable unsatisfiable kinds at enforce; absence-message stays advisory
